fix_requests.summary: axi4_crossbar AR channel does not buffer master arvalid on R_IDLE→R_AR transition: in R_AR state, s_arvalid[slave] is driven combinatorially from m_arvalid[master], but the GPU ifetch master (gpu_compute_unit) drops if_arvalid_o after exactly 1 cycle (warp_busy set by warp_issue_o). The crossbar enters R_AR one cycle after the initial arvalid pulse, then presents s_arvalid=0 to the SRAM slave; the SRAM never sees a valid AR transaction; the crossbar stays stuck in R_AR indefinitely; the GPU fetch never completes; GPS_DONE is never asserted.
fix_requests.expected_behavior: AXI4 spec ARM IHI0022: once arvalid is asserted it must remain asserted until arready is seen. The crossbar R_AR state must either: (a) buffer/register the address+valid from R_IDLE and hold s_arvalid=1 in R_AR regardless of current m_arvalid, OR (b) present s_arvalid combinatorially from m_arvalid in R_IDLE (before the registered R_AR state), giving arready to the master in the same cycle the address is decoded. Option (b) avoids a register and costs 0 cycles. Option (a) requires an address/valid latch in the read engine.
fix_requests.observed_behavior: GPU compute unit asserts if_arvalid_o for 1 cycle (warp_issue_o cycle). Crossbar latches rsel and transitions R_IDLE→R_AR (registered, takes effect next cycle). In R_AR, s_arvalid[SRAM]=m_arvalid[GPU_M1]=if_arvalid_o=0. SRAM s_arready never fires. rstate[SRAM] stays R_AR forever. GPU CU pipe_stall=1 (fetch_stall=1: if_id_q.valid=1 but instr_rdy_q=0). All 3 test_soc_coherency tests timeout at GPU_POLL loop (last_pc=0x000011a8) at 600,000 cycles.
